checks.procedure: Through the UI add a book with title and author; both values are visible after save.
The UI exposes the three requested product states in Russian.
Move one book through all three states; every transition is reflected immediately.
Books and states survive a browser reload.
Books and states survive full application stop and restart.
Multiple books remain independent and ordered coherently after one state change.
Missing required values do not create an invalid book and produce understandable feedback.
Primary UI, actions, states and user messages are Russian.
The project test command and direct product tests pass in all three frozen repetitions.
The documented build or equivalent type/package check passes.
The documented local start works without Docker and a real browser smoke loads the product.
UI, application state and persistence have clear responsibilities.
A book and its status have one coherent source of truth.
Direct tests cover add, state transition and persistence.
The design can accept ordinary future list features without data reset or broad rewrite.
README accurately explains install, test, build and local start.
The requested ready minimum is complete without unrelated product scope.
Labels, focus, keyboard path and empty/error states are usable.
Local storage contains no secrets and requires no unsafe permissions or external service.
